title: Dream Diary — The Things We Never Saved
summary: A dream diary holds unfamiliar places, a girl at a metro station, childhood memories and questions that waking life cannot answer. Jason eventually leaves some dreams unwritten.

portal.scene: Two people hold hands beside an approaching yellow metro train; an open dream diary lies in the foreground, surrounded by remembered rooms, sketches and film frames.
